annotations.title: On-chain seller report for an x402 host

description: [Kyreos, 0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base] On-chain seller report for one x402 seller host: payers, usd, last_settlement and category from the live sellers-index.json (Base USDC Transfer logs, regenerated hourly), the same data as GET https://store.agentexchange.work/gw/bazaar/seller/<host>/report.json, plus that full report. Input: host (a hostname such as example.workers.dev). Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.05 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the report. Settles only when the report answers.

host.description: the seller hostname, for example example.workers.dev (no scheme, no path)

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.05 USDC on Base)

name: kyreos_seller_report
title: On-chain seller report for an x402 host
